headline: Bore Rats Sitting on Complete Underworld Map — And Selling Access
body: A document leak corroborated by three independent tunnel sources confirms what corponation security divisions have suspected for years: the Bore Rats have completed a comprehensive cartographic record of the entire Underworld network beneath GLMZ, including 2,300 kilometers of mapped passages, 847 undocumented access shafts, and at least fourteen sub-aquatic corridors running beneath Old Harbor that no surface authority has officially acknowledged. The map — held in distributed encrypted storage across an unknown number of nodes — is reportedly being licensed in segments to verified buyers at prices ranging from 8,000 quanta for a single-district corridor to upward of 200,000 quanta for cross-district arterial routes. 'They're not selling the whole thing to anyone,' said a Graycloak contact who requested anonymity. 'That's the point. The map's value is in Bore Rat custody. The moment one entity holds it all, the Rats lose their leverage.' Axiom Security Services confirmed it is 'investigating the matter' but declined to specify what action it was prepared to take, a statement widely interpreted in The Underworld as confirmation that Axiom's own tunnel incursions have already been quietly catalogued in the dataset.
aftermath: Three rival corponations — Arcturus Defense, Ironclad, and Zheng-Dao — independently attempted to acquire a full copy of the map through proxy buyers between 2187 and 2189; all three attempts were detected and the buyers were never heard from again.
runner_relevance: The map's existence immediately generated the most lucrative single class of runner contracts seen in years — every major corponation, criminal outfit, and independent operator wanted either a full copy, a partial segment, or intelligence on who already held what sections. Data retrieval and infiltration contracts targeting Bore Rat cache sites ranged from 25,000 to 120,000 quanta, making them the highest-paying category in the market. Simultaneously, the Bore Rats themselves became a major employer, hiring runners for counter-intelligence and protection work to guard map nodes and eliminate parties who had seen too much.
